description: Build a day-by-day plan for a Seattle cruise departure, the same plan the seatac.co sailing page shows: fly into Seatac, ride to a hotel near the pier (or straight to the ship on sailing day), the ride to the terminal, and the ride home or one more night after the cruise. Each step has its booking link and cost: ride estimates from Seatac's own pricing (the all-in total with fee and tax when the site shows all-in prices, otherwise whole-dollar fares before fee and tax; final price at booking), typical hotel rates, and a flight comparison link. Needs the ship and sailing date (use find_cruise_sailings first if unsure). Pass hotel_slug from hotel_options to put a hotel in the plan and the total.

after_cruise.description: airport (default): straight to the airport; hotel: one more night in Seattle.

arrival_date.description: Or an exact arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD), up to 14 days before sailing.

arrival_flight.description: Optional arriving flight number, e.g. AS 342, prefilled on the airport ride.

arrive.description: When they fly in: same_day, day_before (default), or two_days_before.

home_airport.description: Optional 3-letter code of the airport they fly from, e.g. ORD.

hotel_name.description: Optional name of another hotel they already booked.

hotel_slug.description: Optional hotel from hotel_options (a previous call) to include in the plan and total.

ship.description: Ship name, any case; partial names work ("Bliss").

name: plan_cruise_trip
title: Plan a Seattle cruise trip
